consequences: Story completion is separate from durable memory approval. Gate failure rolls back evidence and candidate; successful effects leave an actionable review. Legacy effects already marked completed by older builds are not silently reprocessed.
context: Actual r8 installed acceptance found WorldOps shared episode candidates left pending outside the reviewer queue.
decision: Within one Memory owner transaction, persist the evidence and candidate and immediately run its deterministic Gate. Include worldops_episode in never-auto-commit types, resume pending materialization on effect retries and expose the actual review result. Retain r8 evidence and ship a rebuilt r9.
title: Narrative shared memories enter real review
